infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PawTag uses your camera to scan your pet's QR code tag during activation and to scan tags when you find a lost pet.
infoPlist.NSNFCReaderUsageDescription: PawTag uses NFC to read your pet's NFC tag during activation — just tap your phone to the tag.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PawTag uses your location to share where a lost pet was found, helping reunite pets with their owners.
